sights.n: Asahiyama Memorial Park (旭山記念公園)
sights.address: Chūō-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan (between Mt Moiwa and Maruyama)
sights.w: A hillside park between Mt Moiwa and Maruyama built for Sapporo's centenary — its lookout at 137.5 m takes in the whole grid of the city and is one of Sapporo's classic free night-view spots.

sights.n: Sapporo Shiryōkan — former Sapporo Court of Appeals (札幌市資料館)
sights.address: Chūō-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan (west end of Ōdōri Park)
sights.w: The former Sapporo Court of Appeals building at the west end of Ōdōri Park, now the city's Shiryōkan (archive museum).

sights.n: Kotoni Tondenhei Village Barracks Site (琴似屯田兵村兵屋跡)
sights.w: The barracks-house site of the Kotoni tondenhei (farmer-soldier) village — the settlers who laid the groundwork of the town — designated a National Historic Site, with a 'Road of Pioneering History' (開拓の歴史の道) board mapping the tondenhei relics around it.
